Critical: jQuery in head (prod JS depends on it). Self-hosted under assets/.

Slick carousel — CI3 parity. Any [data-slick] auto-inits via slick_init.js.
     Self-hosted (slick-carousel@1.8.1) under assets/slick/ — NOT assets/wla_new/
     (that dir is in our staging excludes, so files under it never reach
     UAT/prod). Without slick.min.css, `.slick-list` loses `overflow: hidden`
     and carousels spill sideways. slick.min.css's relative url()s resolve to
     assets/slick/fonts/ and assets/slick/ajax-loader.gif.

slick-theme provides the native `.slick-dots` styling. Without it, `dots: true`
     carousels render invisible dots (slick.min.css is structural only).

defer: not needed for first paint. Runs before the deferred slick_init.js
     (defer scripts execute in document order), so carousels still auto-init.
     jQuery above stays eager since slick depends on it.

AppConfig bridge — must run before any page-script reads window.AppConfig.
     Endpoint values come from .env only (no in-code defaults); missing keys
     surface as empty strings so the failure is loud.

Bootstrap/Icons retained during migration — scheduled for removal in cleanup phase.

Shared modal styles (location picker + menu item/variant/combo popups).

Runtime brand tokens — DB-driven, applies to every brand (Theobroma, CBTL, new ones).

Analytics — per-brand IDs (web_config) handed to the self-contained analytics.js module.
     The module loads each vendor SDK itself and fires the funnel events. Adding a new provider
     later = add an id key here + one provider object in analytics.js (no other file changes).
UTM capture — writes the first-party utm_data cookie on landing (read server-side at order confirmation)

Banner click tracking — one delegated listener for every banner widget (banners.php
     emits data-banner-id on linked slides). Plain script, not a module: it only reads the
     window.Analytics bridge, so it needs no imports.

Brand USP promo widget — client/getFilterList, using
     window.AppConfig.homeOutletId (this page's resolved "current" outlet,
     since home itself has no outlet context — see HomeController). The menu
     page makes its OWN independent fetch of the same endpoint with the
     actual outlet id (MenuController/menu.js) — same call shape, different
     id source. This module fetches client-side and renders into home.php's
     [data-usp-slot] placeholder, bailing out (rendering nothing) if the
     brand has no live USP, home has no resolvable outlet, or the call
     fails.

Peek-carousel rail: 2 full banners + a slim peek of the next on
             desktop, ~1 full + peek on mobile. slidesToShow (not variableWidth)
             so slick sizes each slide to listWidth / N — a fixed count that
             never slices a banner's CTA mid-text regardless of viewport.
             infinite:false is required: with infinite:true slick CENTERS a
             fractional slidesToShow, splitting the remainder into a big peek on
             BOTH sides (which re-slices adjacent CTAs); left-aligning keeps the
             2 full banners flush-left with only the slim tail peeking. Pure CSS
             scroll-snap fallback holds until slick boots.
